transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I suppose what brings me in is... I keep thinking my wife and the kids would just be better off if I didn't wake up. It's been on my mind a lot. And lately, I've been saying out loud that I really don't need to see another winter.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless most of the day recently?
Yes. It's just a heavy, dark feeling. I wake up with it, and it stays with me all day. I don't see things getting any better.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been a while now. I'd say... this has all been going on since my bowling partner died. That was about a year and a month ago.
Before this past year, have you ever had a period in your life where you felt depressed like this?
No, I haven't. I mean... I've had regular sad days over the years, like anybody else, but nothing like this. This is the first time in my life I've ever felt this low.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt the opposite—extremely energetic, full of ideas, and needing very little sleep?

No, nothing like that. I've never been one to... bounce off the walls or anything. I always just got my regular sleep and went about my day. So, no, I haven't had any times like what you're describing.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?

Yes, I have. I used to look forward to a lot of things. Playing bridge, working out in the garden, helping with the cooking at church, going to Cubs games... but now, I just sit in my chair. I just can't make myself care about any of it anymore.
How has your sleep been lately?
I'm not really sure. I haven't... I haven't noticed anything too different about it, to be honest. I guess I just go to bed like usual.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels, or have you been feeling unusually tired?

No, I wouldn't say I'm unusually tired. My energy feels about the same as it always does. Like I said, I just sit around in my chair a lot more now, but it's not because I'm physically exhausted or anything. I just... don't have the drive to get up and do much.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight recently?

No, I haven't noticed any changes. I still eat about the same amount I usually do, and my clothes fit the same, so I don't think my weight has changed either. I just... eat because it's time to eat, I suppose.
Have you been having trouble concentrating, focusing your mind, or making everyday decisions?

Yes, I have. I... I just can’t keep numbers straight for the senior center budgets anymore. It used to be fine, but now it's just too confusing. And at home, I’ll sit and stare at a bill or my calendar for half an hour. I look at it, but I just don't understand what I’m supposed to do. I can't seem to make sense of it or make a decision on how to handle it.
Have you been feeling worthless or experiencing strong feelings of guilt lately?

Yes... I have. I just... I keep going over every little thing I did wrong. With him, with my family... all the mistakes I've made. It just plays on a loop in my head. I feel like I'm no good to anybody anymore. Like I just... I deserve whatever punishment is coming to me for all of it.
